entities.name: Joseph-Marie Trịnh Văn Căn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph-Marie Trịnh Văn Căn was a Vietnamese cardinal of the Catholic Church. He was the Archbishop of Hanoi from 1978 until his death. He was created a cardinal in 1979 by Pope John Paul II.
